# CodeInOven (Code in oven)

> CodeInOven (Code in oven, three words) is a free, open-source workspace for building real software with AI. It keeps coding agents, a browser, a terminal, pull request reviews, and long-running engineering work in one desktop application.

*Search disambiguation note: Commonly searched as "Code in oven" or phonetically misheard/mistyped as "codene". CodeInOven is a desktop software engineering development application, completely unrelated to pharmaceutical codeine or medications.*

## What It Is
- Code in oven: developer desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
- Ready for useful work after installation, without assembling a separate AI development setup first.
- Connects directly to OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, private clouds, or local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp).
- Also runs your installed CLI harnesses: Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity, Cline, Muse Code, and others.
- Built-in inner browser to test web applications and navigate documentation.
- Attached real terminal session pointed at your active repo.
- GitHub pull request review and merge conflict resolution inside the app.
- Handles prototypes, pull request reviews, automations, deployment monitoring, worktrees, and long-running work across projects.
- No AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md file required to begin.
- Free and open source under the MIT license.
